title: Scaling as length growth changes

design.question: As length growth changes (everything else as the default graph), how much money does each society need, and does the gap between traditional and OSO grow?
design.compare: 4 societies on 4 difficulties (length growth 1, length growth 2, length growth 3, length growth 4)
design.fixed: the simple model: 12 identical agents, equal money each round, no mint, no validation
design.measure: money needed to solve half the targets
design.runs: from the sweeps tagged "one at a time 2026-10-24: length growth"

answer: To solve half the targets, traditional needs 4.9× to 7.2× the money OSO needs. By difficulty: length growth 1 6.8×, length growth 2 7.2×, length growth 3 6.8×, length growth 4 4.9×.
caveats: Read off between the two budgets that bracket half the targets, in log budget.
Each difficulty has its own budget range; "> x" means not reached within it.
